topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: Wow, so it turns out that Alex, someone I've been chatting with online for a while, actually lives just a few blocks away from me! We were just casually talking about different places we loved in the city, and it came up. I never imagined we'd be neighbors. We've decided to meet up for coffee this weekend. It's crazy how these things work out, isn't it? I'm looking forward to seeing how our conversations translate in person. It's a small world, and I'm really intrigued to see how this friendship evolves now.
